title: Crossing the Bar
author: Alfred, Lord Tennyson
rights: 美国：1889 年出版；中国：作者1892 年去世，保护期已满
intro: 丁尼生（1809–1892）是英国维多利亚时代的著名诗人，1850年起担任桂冠诗人。《越过沙洲》（Crossing the Bar）是他晚年的短诗，1889年发表于诗集《德墨忒耳及其他诗》（Demeter and Other Poems）。全诗以船只驶出港口、越过沙洲的意象，写对生命终点的平静期待：没有哀伤，只希望在夜幕降临后，见到引航的“领航者”。
tips: 全诗是一个长句的祈愿，行末逗号处短停，句号处再停。
bar、moaning、flood 等词要读出海水低沉、平缓的感觉。

glossary.bar: 河口沙洲（船只需越过的浅滩）
glossary.moaning: 呜咽般的低沉声响（指浪声）

human.credit: LibriVox 志愿者朗读 · Short Poetry Collection 184 · 08 - Crossing the Bar

segments.text:
Sunset and evening star,
And one clear call for me!
And may there be no moaning of the bar,
When I put out to sea,

But such a tide as moving seems asleep,
Too full for sound and foam,
When that which drew from out the boundless deep
Turns again home.

Twilight and evening bell,
And after that the dark!

And may there be no sadness of farewell,
When I embark;

For tho' from out our bourne of Time and Place
The flood may bear me far,
I hope to see my Pilot face to face
When I have crost the bar.
